newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco diesel, unleaded track NYMEX lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco diesel, unleaded track NYMEX lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel fuel and unleaded gasoline prices fell on Wednesday, tracking easing NYMEX front-month futures in spotty trade, traders said.
Differentials were largely unchanged in late-day talk, leaving spot prices to move lower on the falling April heating oil and unleaded futures.

Chicago winter-grade unleaded was talked 6.75/6.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX April unleaded, and Group Three unleaded gasoline remained 3.75/3.50 cents a gallon under the print for late-month deliveries.
Low sulphur diesel firmed to bids 3.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Chicago on the day and was talked 3.50/3.75 cents over the print in Group Three.
High sulphur diesel was asked 2.10 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago and 1.75 cents over in Group Three, traders said.
